title: Apptivo Review (2026)
intro: All-in-one business suite CRM with Lite, Premium, and Ultimate per-user plans plus Enterprise custom. This review covers pricing posture, CRM capabilities, limitations, and fit based on first-party research — not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Apptivo overall score 6.5/10 from equal-weight CRM criteria. Lite $15/$20, Premium $25/$30, Ultimate $40/$50 annual/monthly per user. Enterprise custom.
verdict: Apptivo: Choose Apptivo when an affordable all-in-one suite matters more than specialist CRM brand depth. Scores reflect first-party research as of 2026-08-16 — not hands-on product testing.
